pattern: CP-07 provider gone quiet; EX-16 warranty route unresolved; IM-P05 chase after repeated calls with no outcome
notes: Real cut after event 038 (Saturday 8 June 2024): full source history, nothing edited. Since Harbour said on 23 May they would consult the supplier, the agency has made three calls (5, 6 and 8 June) and placed five holds with no written answer; the landlord was last updated on 24 May and the tenant has had no oven since 19 May.
